reviews.text: Bike riding in Canada. I’m on a 6 day bike ride, Quebec to Montreal, 180 miles. I’m 81 and my daily morning Yoga with Jessica keeps me limber and strong and enjoying this ride.

Renewal Needed?. Jess does a wonderful job navigating a flow session that is not too fast for beginner and not too slow for intermediate (myself) practitioners. I was hesitant to go through a class due to being too bogged down by the workday slog, however, upon pushing through the first five minutes I was able to recharge and complete a flow. It was a rejuvenating session.
BEST YOGA APP & TEACHER. Jess is the best yoga instructor. Her classes range from beginner to advanced and her technique for teaching is perfection!

reviews.text: Huge price surge post-Thanksgiving. I discovered Jessica’s channel on YouTube 2 years ago, and practicing almost daily to her videos has helped me recover tremendously from childbirth. I used to respect her so much as a yoga teacher and even decided to save up and treat myself to lifetime access to her app for Christmas this year because of how much her videos helped my recovery. It was $250 pre-Thanksgiving. Post-Thanksgiving, the price went up to $500 without any notice, and there’s no way I can afford that now. There is nothing at all that justifies a $500 yoga app when there are so many free yoga resources all over the internet. Now it just looks like they’re being greedy and only want the rich to be able to access wellness resources. Very disappointed and won’t be practicing to her videos anymore.

reviews.text:
Yoga. I am from Highlands Ranch, Colorado and I am 65 years old. Recently retired and I am taking gentle yoga classes at our rec center four days a week sometimes five.

 I have never felt better in my entire life. Mind, Body and Spirit. 

 I was scrolling through YouTube and luckily stumbled upon your 25 minute evening yoga/full body stretch-sweet dreams, bedtime flow. I did it last night and absolutely loved it.

 I have to tell you that I slept so much better peaceful and restful last night than I have in a long time. 

 I am now adding you to my evening practice along with my morning ones.

 I did see on your website that you do offer other free classes, and I have to say that it is greatly appreciated that you are offering that for those of us that already paid for classes where we live.

 You have now become one of my favorite instructors. 

 Thank you so much 
Namaste
 Dana Heiland 🧘‍♀️👏💝

Best yoga instructor. I’ve been following Jess’ yoga flows for 3 years now. She has the most mindful flows that help ease my stress and anxiety after long days of work. Her flows and meditations are the best in my opinion, such an amazing experience that I am so blessed to have.

Amazing app for home practice. I discovered Jess during the pandemic and have been practicing with her almost daily ever since. My favorite thing about her though is how simple and exact her instructions are without over explaining and cluttering your mind with her thoughts and projections onto your own practice. This allows your practice to be meditational in and of itself. I have yet to find another instructor who has mastered this!

Thanks so much!. Fifty years….that is how long I have been doing yoga, intermittently at times but more regularly as I aged and dealt with autoimmune disease. White Lotus videotapes with Tracy Rich helped me for years. Then a local yoga teacher was excellent. Then I found Jessica on Youtube approximately one year ago and that helped so much during this pandemic. Now I just started her app with Yin Yoga and that is exactly what I needed. Thank you so much. I have the feeling that this will be my go-to resource to help with healing.

My Favorite Calm Evening Yoga. I have been captivated by Jessica for many years. You can even say my kids know her as a second women’s voice frequently playing the background. So much that my youngest asked us if we’re going to go to her house for dinner😂

Seriously though, Jess allows for a calming atmosphere and a gentle voice. Music is nice as well not too overpowering. Jess’s Yoga makes me feel like I can briefly shut out the chaos of my household and train my mind to being still. There is never any pushing or bullying remarks…only ever flexibility, kindness, and grace. The grace is with herself, with you, and with the stresses of life. When you can’t hit a move, or when you do are doing your best but not exactly the same as her, she gives you a modifier or opens up dialog about only doing what’s best for your body today or in the present moment. 

I dream of one day going on a yoga retreat with her fingers crossed I can ever afford it. It would be such and honor. 

Thank you for all that you do, girl!
True Yoga. Trying to get yoga right and different instructors. The flow and guidance are just what I needed, thank you…

reviews.text: Well-rounded yoga for a well-rounded life. I’ve been following Jessica’s journey since before her YouTube debut, when she was solely my insta inspiration for her incredible thoracic mobility. Since then, I’ve practiced yoga, Pilates, aerial arts, and contortion, and as an anatomist, I’m rather critical of the explosion of online yoga or other forms of fitness. But with Jessica, she’s thorough and very well educated on the kinesiology of the body, incorporating active, passive, and dynamic stretching into her practice. Many of the drills I do for contortion or Pilates, I also find in Jess’s courses! But she doesn’t just cater to the advanced yogi - she educated on all levels and gets to the heart of the practice, the heart of *you*. Folding meditation and mindfulness into her instruction, she provides a strong pose cushioned with gentle prose, endowing peace & strength. If it wasn’t obvious by now, I can’t recommend Jess’s yoga enough. She’s a guiding light walking with you through this beautifully chaotic journey we call life.

Truly Amazing. I’ve been a part of Jess’s yoga community for quite some time now from first coming across her YouTube videos! This app and subscription is an amazing purchase for those who are looking to continue their yoga practice from the comfort of their own home, place of choice or on the go! Jess offers an amazing variety of classes and meditations for beginners and advanced yogis. This app has changed my practice for the better and I would recommend it to everyone. Thank you Jess!! ❤️

reviews.text: Jessica’s Yoga. I was so blessed to have come upon Jessica’s yoga sessions when Covid first started… it was through You Tube, and I instantly found a connection in her teaching and approach - this came at a very heavy time of my life, and as a result, her yoga sessions resonated with me and gave me a sense of motivation and purpose. I was able to connect to her app shortly after, and I cannot begin to tell you how much she has influenced my life. Jessica, I know you don’t know me, but I wanted to thank you from the bottom of my heart for guiding me and reminding me of the importance of self care, intention and mindfulness. I am truly blessed for the impact you’ve had on my life, and it’s helped me to be a better mother and health care professional ❤️

Highly recommend. I’ve been following Jess on instagram and YouTube for about 3 years now and I have loved it all along. The app gives more variety and a lot more content, and the classes make you relax and happy in the end! Highly recommend

Simply one of the most wonderful yoga teachers out there. No need to think twice about getting this app. Always available: yoga practices of all lengths and to care for all needs. As someone who taught yoga for many years, I know how hard it is to find a teacher you can trust to lead you safely through a practice. Jessica Richburg is an absolute gem. I love her sequences and her approach. Bless you Jess!

The best. She is so grounding and gentle. I went from avoiding doing yoga to now being committed to the mental and physical practice thanks to what a great teacher she is. Worth every dollar and more.

Love the content but the app needs work. I love Jess’s classes and was excited about this App, but the design has some flaws. The words run over some of the graphics, so it’s hard to tell how long they are, etc. I’m sure this is an easy fix so I hope the designers will look into it. Just a tiny bit annoying is all. Doesn’t take away from Jess’s wonderful classes!

I also appreciate her reminders for taking our practise outside of the mat to help live a mindful life. So grateful for all the work she’s done for us!

jessica has changed my life.. jessica’s classes have become a life changing thing for me, and that is no exaggeration. her classes are truly unlike any other teacher I have come across. each class is done with so much care and love, i come every morning and evening to my mat inspired and excited, and walk away feeling so fulfilled and cared for. as a student and full time worker, i don’t have the luxury of attending a yoga studio- but coming to my mat in my small apartment leaves me filling more fulfilled than any fancy studio could. this app is worth every penny <3
The best ♥️👌. You’r very professionnelle

Worth every penny ! Best yoga app/instructor. Discover Jessica on youtube and just love her classes, calming voice, explanations and variations. I am just so happy she made an app and I can easily choose the class I need without any adds or blabla in between. The app is very friendly and straightforward when selecting what you feel like doing. One of the best instructor out there !

Changed my life. I’ve been using this app for two years now and I love it. This was my first introduction to yoga and I’ve not stopped. It’s convenient, easy to get into and Jess is a wonderful instructor. With such a wide range of videos to follow, it’s perfect for when you’re just starting out learning the basics and when you want a challenge. Jess provides a variety of classes so I never get bored and being able to track your progress is motivating. I’ve never been this fit and healthy before!

One of the best yoga teachers online. Jess is a great yoga teacher. When I follow her classes, I never get injured (I have a habit of going “too hard with some poses!), but Jess always reminds the viewer of the correct positioning and she does it with calmness and grace. She also makes sure that at the start and end of each session, you do the appropriate counter poses to rebalance your body after doing particular poses during the session, which reduces potential for injury and rebalances your body and muscles. I also love the regular app updates and the feeling that I can take yoga with me wherever I go. I now have a lifetime subscription. Definitely worth trying her classes and see if you like her style ☺️

Perfect Option for Those on a Budget. First off, this is an amazing option for those who want more structure than youtube videos but have time and money constraints to go to yoga classes in person.

Great free classes for those to try out before deciding to commit. After a week of free classes, I purchased a one month membership to make sure I would really commit to my at-home yoga practice. After the month was over, I knew I needed more and went ahead with the full year. It is so worth it. 

Jess is such an amazing teacher, with a perfect balance between guiding inner peace and pushing you physically. She has ways of describing poses that make sense to me! I’ve been doing yoga for years on and off and her classes are the reason i’d consider myself to be at an intermediate to advanced level yogi!

Calm. I followed Jess on YouTube for a long time, so when she brought out her app I was so excited! She’s one of the few creators I’ve found to be calming in their practice rather than the overly upbeat and chatty instructors you would usually find. I’ve been using her app since she brought it out and I’ve never tried another yoga app since. I even have a few meditation apps but I always find myself going back to Jess, her voice is so calming. The focus really is on yoga for the mind and body, fitness is just a side benefit. I have ADHD so find it hard to stick to things long term but there’s such variety in styles and even length of videos. She does wonders for my mental and physical health, so thank you Jess!
BEAUTIFUL YOGA CLASSES.🥰. I first found you Jess on YouTube during COVID lockdown. I love the app with such diverse classes. I also love my daily reminder pop up on my phone. I stop to reflect.

Best yoga app. Jess is a wonderful, down-to-earth and calm instructor who guides you in a well-paced manner. I love how she speaks only the necessary words. The app has a great content, which offers something for everyone and Jess keeps building on it.

Excellent yoga app. This is the perfect yoga app for people like myself who want quiet supportive classes, there are focussed sessions to improve postures, but a lot of the classes just move from one pose to the next with gentle encouragement, allowing you to get into the flow easily. These courses are all about moving, doing, breathing, relaxing, listening and embracing true essence of yoga. Jess, you are creating a fantastic resource, helping thousands move holistically, keep up the great work.

My favourite yoga teacher. Thank you so much for providing accessible classes for everyday practice. No matter how I’m feeling I can always reach to this app and find something that I resonate with. I love the transitions and positive affirmations through out every class
